CREATE TABLE frpm
(
    CDSCode                                       TEXT not null
        primary key,
    `Academic Year`                               TEXT  null,
    `County Code`                                 TEXT  null,
    `District Code`                               INTEGER         null,
    `School Code`                                 TEXT  null,
    `County Name`                                 TEXT null,
    `District Name`                               TEXT null,
    `School Name`                                 TEXT null,
    `District Type`                               TEXT null,
    `School Type`                                 TEXT null,
    `Educational Option Type`                     TEXT null,
    `NSLP Provision Status`                       TEXT null,
    `Charter School (Y/N)`                        INTEGER    null,
    `Charter School Number`                       TEXT  null,
    `Charter Funding Type`                        TEXT null,
    IRC                                           INTEGER    null,
    `Low Grade`                                   TEXT  null,
    `High Grade`                                  TEXT null,
    `Enrollment (K-12)`                           REAL      null,
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)`                      REAL       null,
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`            REAL       null,
    `FRPM Count (K-12)`                           REAL       null,
    `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`            REAL       null,
    `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`                      REAL       null,
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)`                 REAL       null,
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`       REAL       null,
    `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`                      REAL       null,
    `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`       REAL       null,
    `2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` INTEGER    null,
    foreign key (CDSCode) references schools (CDSCode)
);

CREATE TABLE satscores
(
    cds         TEXT not null
        primary key,
    rtype       TEXT  not null,
    sname       TEXT null,
    dname       TEXT null,
    cname       TEXT null,
    enroll12    INTEGER         not null,

    AvgScrMath  INTEGER          null,
    AvgScrWrite INTEGER          null,
    NumGE1500   INTEGER          null,
    foreign key (cds) references schools (CDSCode)

    MailStreet  TEXT null,
    MailStrAbr  TEXT null,

    MailState   TEXT  null,

    Ext         TEXT  null,
    Website     TEXT null,
    OpenDate    DATE        null,
    ClosedDate  DATE        null,
    Charter     INTEGER    null,
    CharterNum  TEXT  null,
    FundingType TEXT null,
    DOC         TEXT  not null,
    DOCType     TEXT not null,
    SOC         TEXT  null,
    SOCType     TEXT null,
    EdOpsCode   TEXT  null,
    EdOpsName   TEXT null,
    EILCode     TEXT  null,

    AdmEmail2   TEXT null,

q1: SELECT T1."District Code" FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.City = 'Fresno' AND T2.Magnet = 0
q2: SELECT "District Code" FROM frpm WHERE "School Name" IN (SELECT School FROM schools WHERE City = 'Fresno' AND Magnet = 0)

validation_error: insert: IntegrityError: NOT NULL constraint failed: schools.StatusType
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent. Q1 joins frpm with schools on CDSCode and filters by City = 'Fresno' and Magnet = 0, returning District Code from frpm. Q2 filters frpm rows based on whether the School Name exists in schools filtered by City = 'Fresno' and Magnet = 0, returning District Code from frpm. The difference arises when a school name in frpm matches multiple schools in schools with the same name but different CDSCode values, or when a school in schools has Magnet = 0 but no matching row in frpm.
counterexample_dsp: A test case where one school in schools (City = 'Fresno', Magnet = 0) has a matching row in frpm, and another school in schools (City = 'Fresno', Magnet = 0) has a different school name that does not match any row in frpm. This creates a discrepancy in the results of Q1 and Q2.
